title: Guest Folios Brand Standard: Parking Rates and Valet Service by Brand
content:
Parking on a Guest Folio is billed at the figures the brand standard of the hotel's brand sets. Each Ashbury brand fixes its self-parking rate per night, its valet rate per night, whether valet parking is offered at all, whether self-parking is one of the inclusions of the resort fee, and whether parking is charged per night the vehicle is actually parked rather than per night of stay.

## Schedule of brand parking figures

| Brand | Self-parking per night parked | Valet parking per night parked | Valet offered | Self-parking included in the resort fee | Charged per night actually parked |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | $0.00 | $0.00 | No | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | $0.00 | $0.00 | No | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | $18.00 | $32.00 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | $42.00 | $58.00 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | $25.00 | $38.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Reserve | $0.00 | $65.00 | Yes | No | Yes |

All amounts are in US dollars per night a vehicle is parked.

## Reading the schedule

- **Self-parking included in the resort fee.** At Ashbury Resort & Spa self-parking is one of the inclusions of the resort fee, so it is never billed separately on the folio; the self-parking figure of $25.00 is the brand's self-parking rate, not a charge the guest pays in addition to the resort fee.
- **Valet offered.** Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites do not offer valet parking; their valet figure is $0.00 because no valet service exists at those brands.
- **Per night parked.** At every brand parking is charged per night the vehicle is actually parked, not per night of the stay.

## Points of judgement on the schedule

| Question about a brand | Answer the schedule gives |
|---|---|
| Does an Ashbury Grand folio bill self-parking separately? | Yes, at $42.00 per night parked, since self-parking is not a resort-fee inclusion there. |
| Does an Ashbury Resort & Spa folio bill self-parking separately? | No; self-parking is included in its resort fee. |
| Is there a valet rate at Ashbury Inn & Suites? | No; valet parking is not offered at that brand. |
| Which brand has no self-parking charge but offers valet? | Ashbury Reserve: self-parking $0.00, valet $65.00 per night parked. |

Hypothetical illustration: a guest who stays four nights at an Ashbury Hotel and parks a vehicle on three of those nights has three nights parked; at self-parking that is three nights at $18.00.
